mapping.notes: get_transactions uses account display-name labels (not numeric ids). Fill after Monarch link. personalAccountLabels maps owner id → label array. personalCycle optionally maps owner id → { accountLabel, startDay } — startDay is the first day of that owner's personal statement window (same convention as joint's 25th). Checking/cash labels never define the window. Monarch get_accounts does not expose statement due dates; dueDate is stored on cardBalances only when the account object carries one.
